summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 25, 2026, reporting an amended NI 43-101 technical report for the Tulkubash and Kyzyltash Chaarat Gold Project in Kyrgyzstan. The amendment corrects a typographical error in tables where silver grade data was mislabeled under gold grade, but does not change mineral resource estimates, conclusions, or recommendations from the original report, which remains effective October 15, 2025. This is a routine regulatory correction filing, not a special situation.
